text_en: When the sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, so that they might go and anoint him.
text_cn: 安息日一过，玛利亚玛达肋纳、雅各伯的母亲玛利亚和撒罗默买了香料，要去傅抹耶稣。

text_en: And very early on the first day of the week, when the sun had risen, they went to the tomb.
text_cn: 一周的第一天，大清早，她们来到坟墓那里；那时，太阳刚升起。

text_en: They had been saying to one another, “Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance to the tomb? ”
text_cn: 她们彼此说：“谁给我们从坟墓门口滚开那块石头呢？”

text_en: When they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had already been rolled back.
text_cn: 但举目一望，看见那块很大的石头已经滚开了。

text_en: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man, dressed in a white robe, sitting on the right side; and they were alarmed.
text_cn: 她们进了坟墓，看见一个少年人，坐在右边，穿着白衣，就非常惊恐。

text_en: But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed; you are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He has been raised; he is not here. Look, there is the place they laid him.
text_cn: 那少年人向她们说：“不要惊惶！你们寻找那被钉在十字架上的纳匝肋人耶稣，他已经复活了，不在这里了；请看安放过他的地方！

text_en: But go, tell his disciples and Peter that he is going ahead of you to Galilee; there you will see him, just as he told you. ”
text_cn: 但是你们去，告诉他的门徒和伯多禄说：他在你们以先往加里肋亚去，在那里你们要看见他，就如他所告诉你们的。”

text_en: So they went out and fled from the tomb, for terror and amazement had seized them; and they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid. The Shorter Ending of Mark [[And all that had been commanded them they told briefly to those around Peter. And afterward Jesus himself sent out through them, from east to west, the sacred and imperishable proclamation of eternal salvation. ]] The Longer Ending of Mark
text_cn: 她们一出来，就从坟墓那里逃跑了，因为战栗和恐惧攫（jué）住了她们，她们什么也没有给人说，因为她们害怕。

text_en: [[Now after he rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
text_cn: 一周的第一天，清早，耶稣复活后，首先显现给玛利亚玛达肋纳：耶稣曾从她身上逐出过七个魔鬼。

text_en: She went out and told those who had been with him, while they were mourning and weeping.
text_cn: 她去报告那些一向同耶稣在一起的人，那时，他们正在哀号哭涕。

text_en: But when they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they would not believe it.
text_cn: 他们听说耶稣活了，并显现于她，他们却不相信。

text_en: After this he appeared in another form to two of them, as they were walking into the country.
text_cn: 此后，他们中有两个人往乡下去；走路的时候，耶稣藉了另一个形状显现给他们。

text_en: And they went back and told the rest, but they did not believe them.
text_cn: 他们就去报告其余的人，但那些人对他们也不相信。

text_en: Later he appeared to the eleven themselves as they were sitting at the table; and he upbraided them for their lack of faith and stubbornness, because they had not believed those who saw him after he had risen.
text_cn: 最后，当他们十一人坐席的时候，耶稣显现给他们，责斥他们的无信和心硬，因为他们不信那些在他由死者中复活后，见了他的人。

text_en: And he said to them, “Go into all the world and proclaim the good news to the whole creation.
text_cn: 然后耶稣对他们说：“你们往普天下去，向一切受造物宣传福音，

text_en: The one who believes and is baptized will be saved; but the one who does not believe will be condemned.
text_cn: 信而受洗的必要得救；但不信的必被判罪。

text_en: And these signs will accompany those who believe: by using my name they will cast out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
text_cn: 信的人必有这些奇迹随着他们：因我的名驱逐魔鬼，说新语言，

text_en: they will pick up snakes in their hands, and if they drink any deadly thing, it will not hurt them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will recover. ”
text_cn: 手拿毒蛇，甚或喝了什么致死的毒物，也决不受害；按手在病人身上，可使人痊愈。”

text_en: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
text_cn: 主耶稣给他们说了这些话以后，就被接升天，坐在天主的右边。

text_en: And they went out and proclaimed the good news everywhere, while the Lord worked with them and confirmed the message by the signs that accompanied it. ]]
text_cn: 他们出去，到处宣讲，主与他们合作，并以奇迹相随，证实所传的道理。
